selected_strategy.name: Maximize Margin
selected_strategy.description: Focus on improving profit margins through pricing and cost control.

recommended_actions.title: Implement Strategic Price Increase
recommended_actions.description: Increase prices by 5% ($29.67 → $31.15/unit). Implement gradually and monitor conversion rate impact. Use A/B testing to validate.
steps: Identify products with inelastic demand (high repeat purchase)
Test 3-5% price increase on those products first
Monitor conversion rate daily for 2 weeks
If conversion holds, expand to more products
Use value-add bundling to justify higher prices

recommended_actions.title: Improve Profit Margins
recommended_actions.description: Improve net margin by 5pp (from 9.3% to 14.3%) through combined cost reduction and selective price increases.
steps: Analyze margin by product to identify low-margin items
Test 3-5% price increase on top-selling products
Optimize shipping by comparing carrier rates
Monitor customer response to pricing changes

recommended_actions.title: Scale Advertising Budget
recommended_actions.description: Increase ad budget by 30% ($900.00). At 80% of current ROAS (5.0x), expect $3600.00 additional revenue.
steps: Identify top-performing ad sets by ROAS
Increase budget by 20-30% on proven campaigns
Launch lookalike audiences based on best converters
Set up daily ROAS monitoring with kill switch at 1.5x
Review results after 7 days and adjust
